items.name: ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search
items.one_liner: AI-powered job search and application tool
items.pain_point: Job seekers struggle with tailoring applications and preparing for interviews; recruiters need efficient tools to evaluate candidates
app_ideas: Freemium web app for job seekers with AI-powered CV tailoring and cover letter generation
B2B API wrapper for recruiters to integrate AI-powered candidate evaluation into their ATS
Vertical SaaS for tech job seekers with AI-powered interview preparation and mock interviews
items.monetization: Freemium with premium features for job seekers; B2B API wrapper with tiered pricing for recruiters
items.why_now: Increased demand for AI-powered tools in the job search and recruitment space

items.name: Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps
items.one_liner: Curated collection of 100+ open-source LLM agent templates
items.pain_point: Developers waste weeks reverse-engineering agent patterns; solo devs and startups need production-ready templates they can ship fast
app_ideas: Agent Builder SaaS - no-code drag-drop interface for chaining LLM agents with pre-built skill blocks
RAG API Service - one-click document ingestion + Q&A endpoint for developers不想自己搭建
AI Workflow Automator - connect agents to internal tools (Slack, Notion, DBs) with visual orchestration
items.monetization: Freemium with usage-based API pricing; B2B enterprise tier at $500-2000/mo for compliance, SSO, analytics
items.why_now: LLM inference costs dropped 90% making agent workflows economically viable while enterprises are still hunting for turnkey solutions

items.name: github/spec-kit
items.one_liner: Starter toolkit for structured software design and development processes
items.pain_point: Developers and small teams lack standardized starting templates and workflows for consistent project kickoffs and documentation
app_ideas: Web-based spec editor with collaborative templates and AI-assisted document generation
CLI tool that scaffolds entire project structures from structured spec inputs
Notion-like wiki for engineering teams with built-in spec templates and process workflows
items.monetization: freemium with team/enterprise tiers for collaboration features and integrations
items.why_now: AI coding boom makes spec-driven development essential and remote work increases demand for async documentation tools

items.name: deanpeters/Product-Manager-Skills
items.one_liner: PM skills framework that makes AI coding agents product-smart
items.pain_point: AI coding agents write code but lack product judgment—solo devs and startups using AI agents need structured PM thinking to avoid building the wrong things
app_ideas: VS Code extension: PM sidebar that guides AI pair programming with framework prompts
CLI tool: local product manager agent that reviews specs and roadmaps for AI-generated code
SaaS API: product management layer that AI agents call before writing code
items.monetization: B2B API wrapper (sell to AI agent developers) + freemium dev tools
items.why_now: AI coding agents hit mainstream in 2024-2025 but none have product management skills—this gap is now visible and growing

items.name: nguyenlevel/product-manager-skills
items.one_liner: Product management framework for AI agents
items.pain_point: Helps product managers and teams build AI agents efficiently, saving time and resources
app_ideas: AI agent training and deployment platform
items.monetization: Freemium with enterprise pricing for advanced features
items.why_now: Increased demand for AI agents and product management tools
